name: RunCloud
line: Manage web apps and servers from a hosted control panel.

free.text: 7-day trial; payment method required; charge starts day 8

cells.regions: App uses provider region; dashboard region unlisted
cells.selfhost: No; hosted SaaS with proprietary server agent

work.math: Essentials is $9 a month. 20 builds of five minutes each use the server or outside CI, while the provider's server, domain, storage and transfer costs are separate.
$9 a month for Essentials covers one server. The provider's server with 1 vCPU and 1 GiB for 730 hours is not priced. RunCloud recommends 2 GB or more of RAM for significant traffic.
Business Docker Stacks is $49 a month for a custom app and Postgres stack. RunCloud has no hosted Postgres. The server, storage, network and outside backups cost extra.
